adaptations.withheld: sacred or restricted dance: no teaching adaptations

learning_units.description: Grapevine step progression in a connected hand-holding line.
Executing the inward counter-clockwise spiral and turn outward to face oncoming dancers.

prerequisites.description: Ability to perform a side-stepping grapevine movement in synchronization with a group line.

social_formats.description: Connected group line holding hands led by a single leader coiling and uncoiling.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: All members present hold hands continuously along the line.
movement_profile.footwork: Grapevine step used throughout the progression.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Single file line entering in counter-clockwise spiral, turning inward to uncoil clockwise face-to-face.
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Facing along the path of movement, pivoting 180 degrees at the central turn.
movement_profile.partnering: Connected line holding hands; brief face-to-face encounters with passing line members (sometimes including a kiss).
movement_profile.posture: Upright, connected hand-to-hand in a continuous line.

signature_moves.description: Side-stepping footwork carrying the connected line in counter-clockwise and clockwise spirals.
signature_moves.name: Grapevine line step

signature_moves.description: The leader turns around near the center of the spiral to face the incoming line and lead them back out clockwise.
signature_moves.name: The Center Turn

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Breaking hand contacts, disrupting line spacing, or forcing unwanted physical intimacy during face-to-face passes.

music_profile.musical_form: Continuous repetitive ritual chant accompanying physical winding
music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Rhythmic pulse supported by drumming group and singing
music_profile.sound_description: Live collective percussion and group chant that builds momentum as the spiral winds and unwinds.
music_profile.vocal_style: Chant or song sung by participants and music group

basic_steps: Join hands with neighbors to form a connected line.
Execute a rhythmic grapevine step continuously.
Follow the leader counter-clockwise as the line coils inward.
Turn 180 degrees with the leader to face passing dancers and move clockwise outward.
teaching.formation: Single-file line holding hands, coiling counter-clockwise into a spiral and uncoiling clockwise.
teaching.level_notes: Accessible to beginners; relies on maintaining line contact and grapevine footwork.
teaching.rhythm: Steady rhythmic pulse driven by live drumming and collective chant.
